description: Deterministic validation rules for loan performance data

rules.name: balance_exceeds_original
rules.description: Current balance should not exceed original balance (unless modification)

rules.name: negative_balance
rules.description: Current balance should not be negative

rules.name: dpd_status_mismatch
rules.description: Days past due should be consistent with current status

rules.name: negative_remaining_term
rules.description: Remaining term should not be negative

rules.name: future_origination
rules.description: Origination date should not be after reporting date

rules.name: closed_with_balance
rules.description: Prepaid or defaulted loans should have zero or near-zero balance

rules.name: stale_update
rules.description: Last updated date is more than 6 months before reporting month

rules.name: missing_documentation
rules.description: Active loans should not have missing documentation

rules.name: source_conflict
rules.description: Balance or status differs between primary and servicer systems

rules.name: impossible_transition
rules.description: Loan should not transition from Default/Prepaid back to Current
